svg.title: Same demand, two rules: selfish routing piles onto one corridor, Traffic Hive spreads drivers across three
svg.text: One origin, one destination, three real corridors. Only the routing rule changes.
every driver takes what looks fastest
the hive prices congestion and shares it
animation is illustrative · geometry from corridors.json · numbers from pipeline.evaluate
